findings.title: Sanitized config copy is discarded
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into local `config` and converts schedule_type to a human-readable display value, but then returns `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original) in the context dict instead of `config`. The sanitization is dead code and the raw schedule_type is always emitted. Use the local `config` variable in the return value.

findings.title: No length check before creating incident from threshold window
findings.body: previous_checkins is sliced to failure_issue_threshold and only checked for an OK status, but its length is never compared to the threshold. If fewer rows exist than the threshold (e.g. first failure with threshold 3) the code still flips status to ERROR and indexes previous_checkins[0] to create an incident, firing the incident early. If the threshold is 0 or the query returns no rows it IndexErrors at starting_checkin = previous_checkins[0]. Guard with len(previous_checkins) < failure_issue_threshold: return False.
